Binary_Search.title: Lakeside Trail (Easy Version)
Binary_Search.time_complexity: O(N^2 log(10^9)) -> Global bounding over circular distances inside BS.
Binary_Search.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array storage only, zero DP matrix overhead.

Binary_Search.title: Lakeside Trail (Hard Version)
Binary_Search.time_complexity: O(N log(MAX_H)) -> Binary Search with O(N) circular DP propagation.
Binary_Search.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat static arrays, ZERO dynamic allocation.
Binary_Search.formula_used: req[curr] = max(req[curr], req[neighbor] - S) via 2-pass zero-modulo propagation

Game_Theory.title: Hey It's Me Souvlakity
Game_Theory.formula_used: Binary string ownership range evaluation; score = lastIndex('1') - firstIndex('1') for count >= 3, with base states for count <= 2

Game_Theory.problem_name: I Know About a Million Things
Game_Theory.title: I Know About a Million Things
Game_Theory.time_complexity: O(N) -> Pure byte-level custom parser. Zero reflection overhead.
Game_Theory.space_complexity: O(1) -> Absolute bare-metal. Slices bypassed entirely.
Game_Theory.formula_used: Parity state-space reduction; terminal losing states: (evens == 0 && odds == 3) || (evens == 1 && odds == 1)

Game_Theory.title: MEX Game
Game_Theory.formula_used: Find smallest M where count[M] < 2k. Alice wins iff count[M] == 2k - 1.

Game_Theory.title: Alice, Bob and Stones
Game_Theory.formula_used: Game is fixed-length. Moves parity depends only on piles where i % (k + 1) == 1.

Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass from left and right.
Greedy.formula_used: Find leftmost possible 1 and rightmost possible 1, make everything between them 0.

Greedy.title: Floor of MEX (Easy Version)
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> Constructive maximal subset using difference array.
Greedy.formula_used: diff[a_k * k]++, diff[min(n, (a_k+1)*k)]--; Maximal subset bypasses forbidden ranges

Greedy.title: K Is Important
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> Pure mathematical reduction of the state space.
Greedy.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array storage, O(1) auxiliary space.
Greedy.formula_used: ops = min(k-1, n-k+1); score = sum(max(pairs)) + sum(middle_removals_if_any)

Greedy.title: Prefix
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> State space collapse to tracking min/max prefix sums
Greedy.formula_used: s_new ∈ {a_i, s + a_i, 2s + a_i}; track only min_s and max_s

Greedy.title: Reimu Hakurei and the Youkai
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Single sort + linear bound evaluation.
Greedy.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat static array, ZERO dynamic allocation.

Greedy.title: Letters Down
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass with interval marking.
Greedy.space_complexity: O(1) -> 26-element boolean array for the alphabet.
Greedy.formula_used: Total unique alphabet adjacent edges required to bridge all differing pairs.

Math.title: Monocarp and Projects
Math.formula_used: (y + i) % (x + i) == (y - x) % (x + i); early termination with remaining * (y - x) when x + i > y - x

Math.title: GCD Treasury
Math.time_complexity: O(sqrt(X) + N * k) -> Factorize X only, then sweep array for each prime factor.
Math.formula_used: max over all prime factors 'p' of x: sum of all a_i where a_i % p == 0

Math.title: KiaKio
Math.formula_used: Sum of digit squares cycle convergence followed by combinatorics sum(c * (c - 1) / 2) over equivalence classes

Math.title: Robot Odd Moves
Math.formula_used: if b > a+1 { -1 } else if a%2 == b%2 { a } else { a+1 }

Math.title: The Projections of Paco
Math.formula_used: pos = 2 * a_i - pos; solve for initial p giving final pos = 0

Math.title: In Search of Convenience
Math.formula_used: (x - x0)^2 + (y - y0)^2 = R^2; setting y = y0 simplifies to (x0 + R, y0)

Math.title: Perfect Sandwiches
Math.time_complexity: O(1) -> Pure mathematical derivation, zero loops.
Math.formula_used: min(b, a - b) if a > b else -1

Math.title: Problem from Malinovka
Math.time_complexity: O(N sqrt(N) * density) -> Bit-packed L3-cache-friendly triangle listing.
Math.space_complexity: O(N log N) -> Compressed uint16_t/uint32_t flat arrays (~19 MB).
Math.formula_used: x=pq*u^2, y=qr*v^2, z=rp*w^2; p=1 folded on-the-fly, p>=2 via single-fetch tag_w[]

Math.title: Three Piles
Math.space_complexity: O(1) -> Three stack integers, zero allocation.
Math.formula_used: b - a == 1 && c - b == 1 (given a <= b <= c)

Math.title: Value Counters
Math.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single mathematical pass to determine unique positions.
Math.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat arrays for permutation construction.
Math.formula_used: pos = b[v] + n + 1 - v; Derived from canceling out L_v in pair counts.

Matrices.title: Min Matrices
Matrices.formula_used: Constructive matrix filling: diagonal mins i+1 for i < x where x = 2n - k, row/col mins for >= x, and sequential filler

Prefix_Sum.title: Subarrays
Prefix_Sum.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass with delayed mapping.
Prefix_Sum.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array allocations for prefixes and tracking counts.
Prefix_Sum.formula_used: prefix_sum[r] % k == prefix_sum[l-1] % k with a sliding delayed map (delay = k)

Prefix_Sum.title: Problem from Yuzhnouralsk
Prefix_Sum.category: Prefix Sum / Divide and Conquer / Math
Prefix_Sum.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Flat-array Merge Sort inversion count.
Prefix_Sum.space_complexity: O(N) -> Two static long long arrays (~3.2 MB), ZERO heap allocation.
Prefix_Sum.formula_used: Op at i swaps P[i-1] and P[i]. Valid iff all P[k] >= 0; min ops = inversions(P[1..n]).

Sorting.title: Fashionable Array
Sorting.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Single pass grouping followed by custom sort.
Sorting.space_complexity: O(N) -> Map and vector storage for elements.
Sorting.formula_used: Sort by occurrence rank (ascending), then by value (descending)

Sorting.title: Unrequited Love
Sorting.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Standard sorting for frequency counting. Simple, clean, and cache-friendly.
Sorting.space_complexity: O(N) -> Single slice allocation, no map overhead.
Sorting.formula_used: Triad mapping v[i] = a[i] + a[i+2] - a[i+4], sorted frequency count sum(c * (c - 1) / 2) minus overlapping distance-2 and distance-4 pairs

Sorting.title: 2290C
Sorting.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Single sort + linear 3-bucket partition.
Sorting.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat static arrays, ZERO dynamic allocation.

Stacks.title: Did Not Go to Print
Stacks.formula_used: Monotonic stack simulation for document cancellation ('1' push, '2' pop/print, '3' print)

Stacks.title: Problem from Ust-Katav
Stacks.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single-pass monotonic stack without L/R arrays.
Stacks.space_complexity: O(N) -> Only two flat int arrays (~1.6 MB), ZERO heap allocation.
Stacks.formula_used: a = i - L[i], b = R[i] - i; contribution = (a == 1 || b == 1) ? (a + b - 1) : 2

Strings.title: Replace and Compress
Strings.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass string scan. Zero actual compression simulations.
Strings.space_complexity: O(N) -> To store the string in memory, optimal for 3*10^5 constraints.
Strings.formula_used: String invariance scan: total unique lengths = 1 + canIncrease (if s[i-1]==s[i]==s[i+1]) + canDecrease (if s[i-1]!=s[i]!=s[i+1])

Strings.title: Stubborn Pen
Strings.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single linear pass over stack buffer.
Strings.space_complexity: O(1) -> Fixed 105-byte stack char array, ZERO heap allocation.

Trees.title: The Problem from Silach
Trees.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Worst-case O(log N) Leftist Max-Heap merge & pop.
Trees.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat static arrays, ZERO std::set / heap allocation.
Trees.formula_used: x in W(L) survives match u iff x < max(W(R)) + d; eliminated x gets ans[x] = dep[x] - dep[u]

Trees.title: Extra Road
Trees.space_complexity: O(N) -> Flat static arrays (Forward Star), ZERO dynamic allocation.
Trees.formula_used: K = max(third_max_at_root, max_{x!=1}(second_max_at_x)); ans = n - K

Two_Pointers.title: Rumb Needs a Hand
Two_Pointers.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single inward pass using two pointers.
Two_Pointers.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array storage, O(1) auxiliary space.
Two_Pointers.formula_used: Symmetric matching for misplaced elements: p[left] == right && p[right] == left

Two_Pointers.title: Turn Into a Palindrome
Two_Pointers.formula_used: cost = 1 if one char is c, cost = 2 if neither is c for non-matching pairs
